logo.note: One-colour emblem, no background plate. The supplied JPG painted the mark on a solid #003926 square that is not in the palette, so the plate was removed by alpha un-matte (scripts/derive-brand-marks.ps1) and the mark is inked per ground: Main Text #F4F2EE on the ground and footer, and the ground #2F332B on theme-paper pages. Mark geometry is untouched. The tile is only for the browser/app icon, where a container colour is correct. When the final SVG is supplied, drop it in at approvedAssetPath and replace the two PNG paths.
